normalization.symbol: uppercase supplier code with exchange suffix
normalization.volume_shares: Tushare vol is multiplied by 100 to convert lots to shares
normalization.amount_cny: Tushare amount is multiplied by 1000 to convert thousand CNY to CNY
normalization.market_cap_cny: Tushare total_mv and circ_mv are multiplied by 10000 to convert ten-thousand CNY to CNY
normalization.is_suspended: only an explicit supplier suspension record sets true; an absent daily row is not reclassified as suspension

validation: rows are emitted in declared sort order
open, high, low, close, pre_close, volume_shares, amount_cny, total_market_cap_cny, float_market_cap_cny, up_limit, and down_limit are non-negative when present
high is not below open, close, or low when all values are present
low is not above open, close, or high when all values are present
adj_factor is strictly positive when present
every session exists as an open trading_calendar session for the symbol exchange
session is within the security list and delist bounds when those bounds are present
